hooks: Do you ever stare into your fridge wondering what to cook?
Are you tired of letting fresh groceries go to waste each week?
Do you struggle to make meals from random leftover ingredients?
hook_card_prompt: Top down shot of an organized rustic kitchen counter with fresh colorful vegetables, herbs, olive oil, warm atmospheric lighting, soft shadows, cinematic depth of field.

problem.voice_line: People waste food and time because they do not know what to cook with what they already have.

claims.text: People waste food and time because they do not know what to cook with what they already have.

demos.voice_line: Snap a photo of your fridge to detect ingredients from one photo. You capture the open fridge with the camera button. The screen shows the open fridge.

claims.text: Snap a photo of your fridge to detect ingredients from one photo.
You capture the open fridge with the camera button.
The screen shows the open fridge.

demos.voice_line: Get three recipes ranked by how many of your ingredients they use. Three recipe cards slide in on screen. Matched ingredients are highlighted on the cards.

how.voice_line: The backend detects ingredients from one photo of the open fridge. It ranks three recipes by how many of your ingredients they use.

impact.voice_line: Busy home cooks and students save time and stop wasting food.
